examples.pie: swésor h₂ówins h₂ml̥ǵdʰí. nu bʰréh₂ter wr̥h₁énes tetr̥pḗr. h₁íh₂n̥s h₂mélǵmi. h₂ólut bʰére. nu ǵénh₁tōr swesrés wókʷm̥ h₂wéyst.
examples.en: Sister, milk the sheep! Brother, the lambs are sated. I am milking them. Bring the beer! The parent heard the sister's voice.

examples.pie: ḱéywom h₂ólut yése péh₂wr̥ dʰégʷʰeti. gʰostéyey h₂ólut pékʷete. gʰóstis srobʰéyeti ḱéywom-kʷe ḱḗr méwdt. nu ḱéywe ph₃dʰí sh₂dʰí-kʷe.
examples.en: Boil, dear beer, boil, the fire burns. Cook the beer for the guest! The guest sips, and the dear heart became joyful. Dear one, drink, and be sated!

examples.pie: léwbʰōs wíHrōs wódr̥ déh₂nus bʰérete. swésor wódr̥ limnés bʰére. nu léymō stéwdt gʰostéyey h₂ólut dh₃dʰí. nu mē h₃slidʰté nu wéǵʰete.
examples.en: Carry the water from the river, dear men! Sister, carry the water from the lake. The lake has become cold. Give beer to the guest! Do not slip! Keep carrying!

root.gloss: to dwell, live, reside; to stay, spend the night

examples.pie: wéǵʰont yugtṓs h₁éḱwōs h₃énHesh₂.

examples.pie: súHnew swóm ph₂térm̥ ḱléwse. bʰréh₂term̥ mē stunéds. ph₂tréy dʰrówgʰom mē wérh₁yes. swésōr bʰréh₂term̥ sékʷetor. dwóh₁ bʰréh₂terh₁e h₃énHos bʰéretes. ph₂tḗr méh₂tēr-kʷe dʰugh₂térm̥ h₂életes.
examples.en: Son, listen to your own father. Do not strike a brother. Do not speak a lie to your father. The sister follows the brother. Two brothers carry the load. Father and mother nourish the daughter.

examples.pie: sóh₂wl̥ dʰéǵʰōm lowkéyeti. lówksneh₂ kʷsépm̥ lowkéyeti.

examples.pie: kʷíh₁ h₁ludʰés? deywṓs h₁mé h₂léksont ḱwṓ-kʷe h₁mé wédʰet. ǵʰwērés bʰéwgm̥ nésm̥-kʷe.
examples.en: "How did you come?" "The gods protected me, and the dog led me. I fled from the beast and returned home unharmed."

examples.pie: kʷíd swésor bʰúHt? méne bʰréh₂tēr pérwr̥ gʷéh₂t ne-kʷe nést. deywṓs h₁ím h₂léksōnti gʷémeti-kʷe.
examples.en: "Sister, what has happened?" "My brother went to the mountain and did not return." "The gods will protect him, and he will come."

examples.pie: kʷís h₂nér h₁ési? méh₂ter téwe suHnús h₁ésmi. méne suHnús pérwr̥ gʷéh₂t ne-kʷe nést. méh₂ter nésm̥. téwe wékʷos ǵn̥néh₃mi.
examples.en: "Man, who are you?" "Mother, I am your son." "My son went to the mountain and did not return." "I have returned, mother." "I know your word!"

examples.pie: nu h₂wĺ̥h₁na pĺ̥h₂seh₂es bʰuHdʰí. nu swésōr ǵʰiméni gʷʰr̥yéh₁t mē studyéh₁t.
examples.en: Now, wool, become garments! May the sister become warm in winter, may she not become cold.

examples.pie: kʷíd sruméni nigʷtóm h₁ésti? pĺ̥h₂seh₂ nigʷtéh₂ h₁ésti.
examples.en: What is washed in the stream? The garment is washed.

examples.pie: méh₂tēr sédyet. h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m tn̥néwt wr̥ǵyét-kʷe. swéh₂ey dʰugh₂tréy pĺ̥h₂seh₂m kʷért. dʰugh₂tḗr pĺ̥h₂seh₂m woséyeto. ǵʰiméni ne stéwdt.
examples.en: The mother was sitting. She stretched the wool, and she worked. She made a garment for her own daughter. The daughter dressed herself in the garment. In winter she did not become cold.

examples.pie: ḱémh₂m̥. ḱósmi dinóy wr̥ǵyés? wr̥ǵyóm póntoh₁i-kʷe stéygʰom. kéh₂re l̥gʰdʰí ssdʰí-kʷe. kéh₂ilos pós h₁ésesi. nu légʰyoh₂.
examples.en: I have grown tired. Were you working today? I was working, and I walked along the path. Lie down, dear one, and sleep! Afterwards you will be well. Now I am lying down.

examples.pie: ph₂ter kóryos h₁éǵʰs h₁éyti h₁ím sékʷōh₂er. ne h₁eh₁lówdʰth₂e. Hwérdʰm̥ ǵʰoysós-kʷe moy HeHḱús. méh₂tr̥h₁ toy ḱósmi ǵʰiméni sddʰí. h₁eǵóh₂ te pós wédʰōh₂.
examples.en: Father, the troop is going out; I shall follow it. You are not grown. I have grown strong, and my spear is swift. Sit with your mother this winter! Afterwards I myself shall lead you.

examples.pie: kʷíh₁ méh₂ter ǵr̥h₂n̥tbʰís h₂roh₁dʰéyōh₂? ḱl̥nudʰí pós-kʷe h₂roh₁dʰéye. mē HréwdHs. h₁yód-kʷe me ne ḱléwonti? nu toy wókʷm̥ tl̥nh₂dʰí. h₁uséws wiHrósyo wékʷos ḱlutóm.
examples.en: Mother, how shall I speak with the elders? Listen, and afterwards speak! Do not cry out! And if they do not hear me? Then lift your voice! The word of a good man is heard.

examples.en: Brother, are you alive? I am alive. The master struck me three times with the whip. Why did he strike you? A calf was lost among the trees. I searched for it, and I did not find it. Lie down. I will bring you water. May the master not see you. You are a true brother to me.

examples.en: Gold is lost; great fame is not lost. A thief steals gold; no one steals fame. It is the reward of the guileless man.

examples.pie: nu me n̥mr̥tóm péh₂wr̥ spéḱye. nu swósyo bʰréh₂tr̥s h₁éḱwom ne klépom. nu h₁ím ǵʰórtōd h₁éǵʰs ne h₁élh₂m̥. h₁yód h₁ím klépom h₁éwsoyh₁s me. nu moy suHnús ḱḗr ǵn̥néh₃ti. nu túH HeHḱú lewkóm-kʷe.
examples.en: Immortal fire, look at me! I did not steal the stallion of my brother. I did not drive it out of the pen. If I stole it, may you burn me. My son knows my heart. You are swift and bright.

examples.en: Two thieves stole a cow by night. It grew light, and the two raged. The old one said: "I stole the cow!" The young one said: "I stole her!" It grew dark. She went to her own home, and the herdsman was milking her.

examples.en: Villager, where does your chief dwell? Come, man! I will lead you to him. Why have you come? My king sent me. Then the chief will hear you.
